THE NIGHT GOES ON ...

And in the Argentinian Patagonia the science fiction of the Stellar Battle movie franchise, gradually turns into a dangerous reality. After Marty's surprise betrayal, Narciso Attacks! Delaying Diego's efforts to rescue Princess Lanor and help her send a warning message to her generals.

MEANWHILE ... 

On the other side of the galaxy her cinematographic look-alike, collaborates with the enemy to steal the map that leads to the last bastion of the rebellion of the four crowns and the Stellar Armada readies itself for war!

BACK ON EARTH ...

The device known as "Harry" has been succesfully charged at the Five's headquarters and, with our unexpected hero (expectedly) missing, it falls on two new recruits to continue and intensify the search and save the day!

KEY FEATURES: 

  • 2D RETRO-STYLE POINT-AND-CLICK ADVENTURE - Travel back to the 80s in this faithfull reproduction of the adventure games from that decade 
  • 16 COLOR PALETTE - Enjoy the artwork done in the same 16 color palette used in games like Maniac Mansion and Zak McKracken
  • 9VERBS UI - Allow yourself to relive the experience of the mythical 9verbs UI in point-and-clicks adventure games
  • FUN PUZZLE DESIGN - Enjoy a fun-oriented puzzle design derive from lightweight storyline.

MADE WITH ADVENTURE GAME STUDIO

Adventure Game Studio (AGS) is an Adventure Engine to create graphical point-and-click adventure games. Download it from here!

ALL CHAPTERS OF STELLAR MESS SAGA

Stellar Mess: The Princess Conundrum (chapter 1)

Stellar Mess: Operation Kush (chapter 2)

Stellar Mess: A galaxy in peril (chapter 3) - TBD

HOW TO PLAY

Stellar Mess is a classic graphic adventure game with a 9verbs UI. That being said, you must play with the mouse and combine this actions with the items or places on the screen above. You will find that the default verb for all items is “Look at” (except for characters where this default verb is “Talk to”), to facilitate access to these actions you can use the following shortcuts: 

Q -> Give ; W -> Pick Up ; E -> Use

A -> Open ; S -> Look at ; D -> Push

Z -> Close ; X -> Talk to ; C -> Pull

I Hope you enjoy it!

LANGUAGE:

Text: English, Spanish

No voice over
